parameters.name: ComponentType
parameters.description:
The component type.

Valid values:
- Build
- Test

parameters.name: ComponentVersion
parameters.description:
The component version number in the major.minor.patch format. Each part must be a non-negative integer. You can also use the wildcard character (*) to replace one part for fuzzy matching.
>This parameter takes effect only when Name is specified.

parameters.name: ImageComponentId
parameters.description: The ID of the image component to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 50.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The image component name. Only exact match is supported.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of `NextToken` returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description:
The image component type. Valid values:

- SELF: custom image components that you created.
- ALIYUN: system components provided by Alibaba Cloud.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID. If you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: SystemType
parameters.description:
The operating system supported by the component.

Valid values:
- Linux
- Windows

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
